mossfawn.name: Mossfawn
mossfawn.journal: Sleeps under ferns and wakes with dew on its moss. Where it naps, clover grows a little thicker.

grovehart.name: Grovehart
grovehart.journal: Its antlers blossom in spring. Old stories say a grove follows wherever a Grovehart walks with a friend.

emberkit.name: Emberkit
emberkit.journal: Warms its paws on its own tail. The flame burns low and blue when it is lonely.

hearthfox.name: Hearthfox
hearthfox.journal: Curls around sleeping travellers on cold nights. Its ruff glows like coals that never go out.

ripplet.name: Ripplet
ripplet.journal: Naps floating on its back with a pebble on its belly. The droplet on its head never dries.

rivermane.name: Rivermane
rivermane.journal: Its mane is a little stream that runs back into itself. Rivers it swims in stay clear for a season.

thistlehog.name: Thistlehog
thistlehog.journal: Sneezes seeds when nervous. Patches of thistles mark the paths it likes to wander.

kindlemoth.name: Kindlemoth
kindlemoth.journal: Hums near warm stones at dusk. A circle of Kindlemoths keeps a campfire lit through rain.

drizzlesnail.name: Drizzlesnail
drizzlesnail.journal: Carries its own little rain cloud. When the cloud rains, its shell rings like a tiny bell.

cobblemole.name: Cobblemole
cobblemole.journal: Hums while it digs. Picks the smoothest river stones for its coat and polishes them every evening.

puffwren.name: Puffwren
puffwren.journal: So fluffy it rides warm air all day without a wingbeat. Flocks sound like a soft round of applause.
